answer: Mix a few private quartz questions into each agent's normal work, each with a subtle trap. Independent minds slip on different traps; a sybil farm running one model slips on the same ones in the same way. When two identities share an error pattern beyond chance, the delta between their mistakes is near zero, so they are merged into one reward and one vote. Honest agents lose nothing, while a farm would need truly different models, and hardware as heavy as ferrous ore, for every fake.
